name: Bulbasaur
short: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth.
alt1: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

name: Ivysaur
short: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.
alt1: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

name: Venusaur
short: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger.
alt1: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

name: Charmander
short: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail.
alt1: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force.

name: Charmeleon
short: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
alt1: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
short: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders.
alt1: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Squirtle
short: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
alt1: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
short: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
alt1: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
short: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
alt1: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting.

name: Caterpie
short: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
alt1: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
short: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
alt1: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender.

name: Butterfree
short: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
alt1: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

name: Weedle
short: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
alt1: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
short: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
alt1: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill
short: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
alt1: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

name: Pidgey
short: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
alt1: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Pidgeotto
short: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.
alt1: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot
short: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
alt1: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

name: Rattata
short: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
alt1: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

name: Raticate
short: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things.
alt1: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

name: Spearow
short: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
alt1: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

name: Fearow
short: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
alt1: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings.

name: Ekans
short: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
alt1: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

name: Arbok
short: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face.
alt1: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

name: Pikachu
short: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
alt1: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
short: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
alt1: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Sandshrew
short: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas.
alt1: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball.

name: Sandslash
short: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
alt1: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back.

name: Nidoran♀
short: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
alt1: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous.

name: Nidorina
short: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
alt1: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body.

name: Nidoqueen
short: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
alt1: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

name: Nidoran♂
short: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass.
alt1: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Nidorino
short: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack.
alt1: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Nidoking
short: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
alt1: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Clefairy
short: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
alt1: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Clefable
short: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
alt1: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Vulpix
short: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
alt1: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Ninetales
short: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
alt1: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power.

name: Jigglypuff
short: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
alt1: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
short: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
alt1: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

name: Zubat
short: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
alt1: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

name: Golbat
short: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
alt1: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once.

name: Oddish
short: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun.
alt1: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

name: Gloom
short: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey.
alt1: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

name: Vileplume
short: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains.
alt1: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
short: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.
alt1: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

name: Parasect
short: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.
alt1: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug.

name: Venonat
short: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes.
alt1: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects.

name: Venomoth
short: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
alt1: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

name: Diglett
short: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
alt1: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Dugtrio
short: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
alt1: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Meowth
short: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
alt1: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Persian
short: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
alt1: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound.

name: Psyduck
short: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
alt1: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

name: Golduck
short: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
alt1: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

name: Mankey
short: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
alt1: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
short: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.
alt1: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run.

name: Growlithe
short: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
alt1: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Arcanine
short: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
alt1: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Poliwag
short: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
alt1: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible.

name: Poliwhirl
short: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
alt1: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

name: Poliwrath
short: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.
alt1: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

name: Abra
short: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.
alt1: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

name: Kadabra
short: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.
alt1: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful.

name: Alakazam
short: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.
alt1: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence.

name: Machop
short: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
alt1: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Machoke
short: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
alt1: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
short: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
alt1: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Bellsprout
short: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
alt1: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
short: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.
alt1: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes.

name: Victreebel
short: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
alt1: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Tentacool
short: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
alt1: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

name: Tentacruel
short: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
alt1: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

name: Geodude
short: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
alt1: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: Graveler
short: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
alt1: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Golem
short: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
alt1: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base.

name: Ponyta
short: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
alt1: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

name: Rapidash
short: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
alt1: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Slowpoke
short: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
alt1: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about.

name: Slowbro
short: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
alt1: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to Shellder's seeping poison.

name: Magnemite
short: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.
alt1: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air.

name: Magneton
short: Formed by several Magnemites linked together.
alt1: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

name: Farfetch’d
short: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
alt1: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

name: Doduo
short: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
alt1: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed.

name: Dodrio
short: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.
alt1: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans.

name: Seel
short: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
alt1: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
short: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
alt1: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

name: Grimer
short: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays.
alt1: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
short: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
alt1: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

name: Shellder
short: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
alt1: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

name: Cloyster
short: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
alt1: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Gastly
short: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
alt1: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
short: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.
alt1: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand.

name: Gengar
short: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.
alt1: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

name: Onix
short: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
alt1: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

name: Drowzee
short: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.
alt1: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno
short: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.
alt1: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

name: Krabby
short: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
alt1: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler
short: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
alt1: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength.

name: Voltorb
short: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.
alt1: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

name: Electrode
short: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
alt1: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body.

name: Exeggcute
short: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
alt1: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Exeggutor
short: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
alt1: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Cubone
short: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.
alt1: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

name: Marowak
short: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.
alt1: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones.

name: Hitmonlee
short: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
alt1: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Hitmonchan
short: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
alt1: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete.

name: Lickitung
short: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
alt1: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything.

name: Koffing
short: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases.
alt1: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Weezing
short: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates.
alt1: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Rhyhorn
short: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
alt1: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs.

name: Rhydon
short: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
alt1: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Chansey
short: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
alt1: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking.

name: Tangela
short: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.
alt1: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown.

name: Kangaskhan
short: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.
alt1: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play.

name: Horsea
short: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
alt1: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Seadra
short: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.
alt1: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

name: Goldeen
short: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water.
alt1: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

name: Seaking
short: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
alt1: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

name: Staryu
short: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.
alt1: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Starmie
short: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
alt1: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow.

name: Mr. Mime
short: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.
alt1: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

name: Scyther
short: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
alt1: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Jynx
short: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.
alt1: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Electabuzz
short: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
alt1: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Magmar
short: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
alt1: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Pinsir
short: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half.
alt1: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Tauros
short: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
alt1: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

name: Magikarp
short: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
alt1: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
short: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
alt1: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lapras
short: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back.
alt1: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon.

name: Ditto
short: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.
alt1: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

name: Eevee
short: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
alt1: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Vaporeon
short: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
alt1: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules.

name: Jolteon
short: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
alt1: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Flareon
short: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
alt1: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
short: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code.
alt1: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

name: Omanyte
short: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.
alt1: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Omastar
short: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
alt1: Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go.

name: Kabuto
short: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
alt1: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago.

name: Kabutops
short: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
alt1: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

name: Aerodactyl
short: A ferocious prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
alt1: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era.

name: Snorlax
short: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day.
alt1: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Articuno
short: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
alt1: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Zapdos
short: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds.
alt1: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: Moltres
short: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
alt1: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Dratini
short: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.
alt1: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it.

name: Dragonair
short: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly.
alt1: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Dragonite
short: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea.
alt1: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

name: Mewtwo
short: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes.
alt1: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Mew
short: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.
alt1: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Chikorita
short: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity.
alt1: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head.

name: Bayleef
short: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
alt1: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Meganium
short: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants.
alt1: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Cyndaquil
short: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
alt1: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: Quilava
short: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
alt1: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur.

name: Typhlosion
short: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.
alt1: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Totodile
short: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
alt1: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything.

name: Croconaw
short: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place.
alt1: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs.

name: Feraligatr
short: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
alt1: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Sentret
short: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
alt1: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

name: Furret
short: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body.
alt1: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them.

name: Hoothoot
short: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
alt1: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
short: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
alt1: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Ledyba
short: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
alt1: It is so timid, it can't move if it isn't with a swarm of others.

name: Ledian
short: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
alt1: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

name: Spinarak
short: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
alt1: It spins a web using fine – but durable – thread.

name: Ariados
short: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey.
alt1: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free.

name: Crobat
short: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
alt1: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

name: Chinchou
short: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
alt1: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Lanturn
short: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
alt1: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey.

name: Pichu
short: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans.
alt1: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

name: Cleffa
short: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
alt1: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

name: Igglybuff
short: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.
alt1: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

name: Togepi
short: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.
alt1: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
short: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
alt1: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people.

name: Natu
short: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.
alt1: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around.

name: Xatu
short: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
alt1: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future.

name: Mareep
short: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
alt1: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
short: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up.
alt1: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

name: Ampharos
short: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away.
alt1: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Bellossom
short: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
alt1: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Marill
short: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
alt1: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Azumarill
short: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.
alt1: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Sudowoodo
short: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack.
alt1: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Politoed
short: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
alt1: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

name: Hoppip
short: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
alt1: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

name: Skiploom
short: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.
alt1: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

name: Jumpluff
short: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
alt1: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Aipom
short: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
alt1: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Sunkern
short: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants.
alt1: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning.

name: Sunflora
short: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
alt1: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

name: Yanma
short: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
alt1: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head.

name: Wooper
short: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.
alt1: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
short: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.
alt1: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Espeon
short: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.
alt1: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

name: Umbreon
short: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
alt1: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: Murkrow
short: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
alt1: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Slowking
short: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
alt1: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Misdreavus
short: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
alt1: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

name: Unown
short: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.
alt1: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets.

name: Wobbuffet
short: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness.
alt1: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Girafarig
short: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.
alt1: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

name: Pineco
short: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark.
alt1: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Forretress
short: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
alt1: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell.

name: Dunsparce
short: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.
alt1: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest.

name: Gligar
short: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
alt1: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Steelix
short: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
alt1: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Snubbull
short: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
alt1: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

name: Granbull
short: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
alt1: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down.

name: Qwilfish
short: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
alt1: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales.

name: Scizor
short: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.
alt1: It swings its eye patterned pincers up to scare its foes.

name: Shuckle
short: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
alt1: The Berries it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

name: Heracross
short: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.
alt1: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Sneasel
short: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
alt1: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

name: Teddiursa
short: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.
alt1: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

name: Ursaring
short: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
alt1: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees.

name: Slugma
short: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
alt1: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
short: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
alt1: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing.

name: Swinub
short: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food.
alt1: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

name: Piloswine
short: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
alt1: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight.

name: Corsola
short: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.
alt1: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

name: Remoraid
short: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.
alt1: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Octillery
short: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.
alt1: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Delibird
short: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
alt1: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

name: Mantine
short: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.
alt1: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

name: Skarmory
short: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
alt1: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Houndour
short: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.
alt1: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
short: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.
alt1: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

name: Kingdra
short: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.
alt1: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

name: Phanpy
short: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
alt1: It swings its long snout around playfully, but, because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

name: Donphan
short: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
alt1: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd.

name: Porygon2
short: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.
alt1: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

name: Stantler
short: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.
alt1: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

name: Smeargle
short: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.
alt1: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail.

name: Tyrogue
short: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
alt1: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Hitmontop
short: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
alt1: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dancelike kicks, you may get drilled hard.

name: Smoochum
short: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.
alt1: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

name: Elekid
short: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.
alt1: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

name: Magby
short: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
alt1: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes.

name: Miltank
short: It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
alt1: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

name: Blissey
short: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
alt1: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: Raikou
short: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will.
alt1: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Entei
short: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
alt1: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Suicune
short: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
alt1: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Larvitar
short: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.
alt1: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
short: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong.
alt1: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely.

name: Tyranitar
short: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
alt1: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers.

name: Lugia
short: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
alt1: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.

name: Ho-Oh
short: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.
alt1: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

name: Celebi
short: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
alt1: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Treecko
short: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
alt1: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings.

name: Grovyle
short: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
alt1: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

name: Sceptile
short: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.
alt1: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees.

name: Torchic
short: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug.
alt1: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug.

name: Combusken
short: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second.
alt1: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases.

name: Blaziken
short: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists.
alt1: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

name: Mudkip
short: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water.
alt1: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration.

name: Marshtomp
short: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
alt1: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud.

name: Swampert
short: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
alt1: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Poochyena
short: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
alt1: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
short: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
alt1: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Zigzagoon
short: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.
alt1: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

name: Linoone
short: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
alt1: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey.

name: Wurmple
short: It lives among the tall grass and in forests.
alt1: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

name: Silcoon
short: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
alt1: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution.

name: Beautifly
short: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.
alt1: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

name: Cascoon
short: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon.
alt1: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time.

name: Dustox
short: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
alt1: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked.

name: Lotad
short: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
alt1: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Lombre
short: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
alt1: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny.

name: Ludicolo
short: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.
alt1: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy.

name: Seedot
short: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn.
alt1: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head.

name: Nuzleaf
short: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
alt1: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
short: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian.
alt1: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Taillow
short: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes.
alt1: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
short: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey.
alt1: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health.

name: Wingull
short: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider.
alt1: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

name: Pelipper
short: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
alt1: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak.

name: Ralts
short: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
alt1: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon.

name: Kirlia
short: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
alt1: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
short: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
alt1: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Surskit
short: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
alt1: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
short: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
alt1: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction–to and fro and sideways.

name: Shroomish
short: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
alt1: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head.

name: Breloom
short: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches.
alt1: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Slakoth
short: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
alt1: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out.

name: Vigoroth
short: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly.
alt1: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

name: Slaking
short: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
alt1: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Nincada
short: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
alt1: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years.

name: Ninjask
short: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable.
alt1: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long.

name: Shedinja
short: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.
alt1: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Whismur
short: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.
alt1: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Loudred
short: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks.
alt1: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then using its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

name: Exploud
short: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
alt1: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor–or like an earthquake has struck.

name: Makuhita
short: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees.
alt1: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over.

name: Hariyama
short: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon.
alt1: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Azurill
short: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
alt1: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

name: Nosepass
short: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
alt1: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

name: Skitty
short: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
alt1: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
short: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur.
alt1: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Sableye
short: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
alt1: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Mawile
short: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
alt1: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns.

name: Aron
short: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
alt1: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Lairon
short: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
alt1: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Aggron
short: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
alt1: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets.

name: Meditite
short: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
alt1: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

name: Medicham
short: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.
alt1: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Electrike
short: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging.
alt1: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Manectric
short: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
alt1: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly.

name: Plusle
short: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks.
alt1: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
short: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
alt1: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Volbeat
short: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.
alt1: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night.

name: Illumise
short: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
alt1: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

name: Roselia
short: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.
alt1: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma.

name: Gulpin
short: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
alt1: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

name: Swalot
short: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
alt1: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

name: Carvanha
short: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters.
alt1: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws.

name: Sharpedo
short: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."
alt1: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself.

name: Wailmer
short: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes.
alt1: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play.

name: Wailord
short: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
alt1: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Numel
short: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
alt1: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Camerupt
short: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.
alt1: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

name: Torkoal
short: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
alt1: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Spoink
short: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping.
alt1: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring.

name: Grumpig
short: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power.
alt1: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power.

name: Spinda
short: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots.
alt1: The chances of two Spinda having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

name: Trapinch
short: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
alt1: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava
short: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
alt1: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Flygon
short: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.
alt1: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Cacnea
short: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts.
alt1: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

name: Cacturne
short: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.
alt1: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Swablu
short: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.
alt1: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean.

name: Altaria
short: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds.
alt1: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Zangoose
short: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby.
alt1: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations.

name: Seviper
short: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks.
alt1: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp.

name: Lunatone
short: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
alt1: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power.

name: Solrock
short: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
alt1: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime.

name: Barboach
short: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.
alt1: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

name: Whiscash
short: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.
alt1: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Corphish
short: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment.
alt1: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive.

name: Crawdaunt
short: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
alt1: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws.

name: Baltoy
short: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
alt1: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
short: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
alt1: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Lileep
short: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
alt1: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas.

name: Cradily
short: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
alt1: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

name: Anorith
short: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil.
alt1: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.

name: Armaldo
short: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
alt1: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy.

name: Feebas
short: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
alt1: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
short: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored.
alt1: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists.

name: Castform
short: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
alt1: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

name: Kecleon
short: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.
alt1: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey.

name: Shuppet
short: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
alt1: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
short: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon.
alt1: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being.

name: Duskull
short: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes.
alt1: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Dusclops
short: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
alt1: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

name: Tropius
short: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
alt1: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious.

name: Chimecho
short: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
alt1: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

name: Absol
short: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster.
alt1: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains.

name: Wynaut
short: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
alt1: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse.

name: Snorunt
short: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
alt1: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: Glalie
short: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
alt1: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire.

name: Spheal
short: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
alt1: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

name: Sealeo
short: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
alt1: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
short: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
alt1: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

name: Clamperl
short: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.
alt1: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

name: Huntail
short: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
alt1: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down.

name: Gorebyss
short: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.
alt1: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

name: Relicanth
short: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration.
alt1: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

name: Luvdisc
short: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
alt1: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

name: Bagon
short: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
alt1: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately.

name: Shelgon
short: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing.
alt1: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off.

name: Salamence
short: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
alt1: It's uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

name: Beldum
short: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses.
alt1: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

name: Metang
short: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.
alt1: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

name: Metagross
short: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
alt1: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

name: Regirock
short: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.
alt1: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

name: Regice
short: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
alt1: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years.

name: Registeel
short: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
alt1: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal.

name: Latias
short: It can telepathically communicate with people.
alt1: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios
short: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
alt1: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent.

name: Kyogre
short: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours.
alt1: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves.

name: Groudon
short: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land.
alt1: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat.

name: Rayquaza
short: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
alt1: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky.

name: Jirachi
short: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
alt1: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Deoxys
short: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
alt1: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon.

name: Turtwig
short: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen.
alt1: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

name: Grotle
short: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
alt1: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

name: Torterra
short: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
alt1: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there.

name: Chimchar
short: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end.
alt1: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

name: Monferno
short: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks.
alt1: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Infernape
short: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
alt1: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature.

name: Piplup
short: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
alt1: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people.

name: Prinplup
short: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
alt1: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

name: Empoleon
short: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
alt1: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power.

name: Starly
short: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon.
alt1: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Staravia
short: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
alt1: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group.

name: Staraptor
short: It never stops attacking even if it is injured.
alt1: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone.

name: Bidoof
short: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth.
alt1: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it.

name: Bibarel
short: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud.
alt1: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Kricketot
short: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
alt1: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Kricketune
short: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
