alt1: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

name: Shinx
short: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
alt1: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity.

name: Luxio
short: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws.
alt1: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting.

name: Luxray
short: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
alt1: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Budew
short: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold.
alt1: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.

name: Roserade
short: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
alt1: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Cranidos
short: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
alt1: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago.

name: Rampardos
short: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
alt1: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.

name: Shieldon
short: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
alt1: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows.

name: Bastiodon
short: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
alt1: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through.

name: Burmy
short: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
alt1: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

name: Wormadam
short: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body.
alt1: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials.

name: Mothim
short: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
alt1: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

name: Combee
short: It collects and delivers honey to its colony.
alt1: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Vespiquen
short: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
alt1: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

name: Pachirisu
short: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
alt1: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity.

name: Buizel
short: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
alt1: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.

name: Floatzel
short: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
alt1: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey.

name: Cherubi
short: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
alt1: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Cherrim
short: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.
alt1: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

name: Shellos
short: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
alt1: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

name: Gastrodon
short: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
alt1: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times.

name: Ambipom
short: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails.
alt1: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Drifloon
short: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."
alt1: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon.

name: Drifblim
short: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds.
alt1: It can generate and release gas within its body.

name: Buneary
short: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
alt1: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

name: Lopunny
short: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
alt1: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

name: Mismagius
short: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
alt1: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe.

name: Honchkrow
short: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.
alt1: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it.

name: Glameow
short: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
alt1: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate.

name: Purugly
short: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
alt1: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

name: Chingling
short: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
alt1: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat.

name: Stunky
short: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
alt1: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear.

name: Skuntank
short: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.
alt1: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack.

name: Bronzor
short: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.
alt1: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs.

name: Bronzong
short: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.
alt1: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain.

name: Bonsly
short: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.
alt1: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes.

name: Mime Jr.
short: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements.
alt1: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

name: Happiny
short: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.
alt1: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

name: Chatot
short: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
alt1: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: Spiritomb
short: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
alt1: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Gible
short: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
alt1: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them.

name: Gabite
short: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
alt1: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

name: Garchomp
short: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
alt1: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors.

name: Munchlax
short: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
alt1: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Riolu
short: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
alt1: They communicate with one another using their auras.

name: Lucario
short: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
alt1: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Hippopotas
short: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs.
alt1: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking.

name: Hippowdon
short: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
alt1: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

name: Skorupi
short: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison.
alt1: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey.

name: Drapion
short: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car.
alt1: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Croagunk
short: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.
alt1: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Toxicroak
short: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
alt1: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

name: Carnivine
short: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
alt1: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.

name: Finneon
short: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
alt1: The line running down its side can store sunlight.

name: Lumineon
short: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
alt1: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce.

name: Mantyke
short: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
alt1: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they'll all fight together to repel attackers.

name: Snover
short: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
alt1: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches.

name: Abomasnow
short: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow.
alt1: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

name: Weavile
short: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
alt1: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Magnezone
short: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field.
alt1: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

name: Lickilicky
short: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
alt1: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything.

name: Rhyperior
short: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them.
alt1: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

name: Tangrowth
short: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.
alt1: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines.

name: Electivire
short: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
alt1: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Magmortar
short: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms.
alt1: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms.

name: Togekiss
short: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.
alt1: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

name: Yanmega
short: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight.
alt1: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Leafeon
short: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
alt1: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

name: Glaceon
short: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
alt1: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

name: Gliscor
short: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
alt1: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches.

name: Mamoswine
short: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
alt1: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years.

name: Porygon-Z
short: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions.
alt1: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions.

name: Gallade
short: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
alt1: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Probopass
short: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
alt1: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies.

name: Dusknoir
short: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
alt1: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

name: Froslass
short: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath.
alt1: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath.

name: Rotom
short: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
alt1: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Uxie
short: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
alt1: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
short: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
alt1: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Azelf
short: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
alt1: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things.

name: Dialga
short: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
alt1: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time.

name: Palkia
short: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
alt1: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours.

name: Heatran
short: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
alt1: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body.

name: Regigigas
short: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
alt1: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Giratina
short: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
alt1: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours.

name: Cresselia
short: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams.
alt1: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil.

name: Phione
short: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
alt1: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Manaphy
short: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
alt1: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
short: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream.
alt1: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Shaymin
short: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it.
alt1: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Arceus
short: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
alt1: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

name: Victini
short: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.
alt1: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Snivy
short: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
alt1: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight.

name: Servine
short: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
alt1: It moves along the ground as if sliding.

name: Serperior
short: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.
alt1: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

name: Tepig
short: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose.
alt1: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Pignite
short: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster.
alt1: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger.

name: Emboar
short: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin.
alt1: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves.

name: Oshawott
short: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
alt1: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws.

name: Dewott
short: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
alt1: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

name: Samurott
short: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent.
alt1: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword.

name: Patrat
short: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days.
alt1: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
short: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
alt1: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Lillipup
short: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
alt1: It faces strong opponents with great courage.

name: Herdier
short: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
alt1: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
short: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains.
alt1: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat.

name: Purrloin
short: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.
alt1: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them.

name: Liepard
short: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed.
alt1: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure.

name: Pansage
short: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon.
alt1: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over.

name: Simisage
short: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
alt1: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail.

name: Pansear
short: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them.
alt1: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F.

name: Simisear
short: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot.
alt1: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Panpour
short: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients.
alt1: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients.

name: Simipour
short: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
alt1: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Munna
short: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
alt1: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Musharna
short: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
alt1: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Pidove
short: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
alt1: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Tranquill
short: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
alt1: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

name: Unfezant
short: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents.
alt1: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

name: Blitzle
short: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity.
alt1: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity.

name: Zebstrika
short: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
alt1: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Roggenrola
short: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
alt1: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure.

name: Boldore
short: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
alt1: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows.

name: Gigalith
short: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
alt1: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

name: Woobat
short: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
alt1: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
short: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
alt1: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Drilbur
short: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
alt1: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Excadrill
short: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests.
alt1: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Audino
short: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
alt1: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Timburr
short: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction.
alt1: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around.

name: Gurdurr
short: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
alt1: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

name: Conkeldurr
short: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
alt1: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

name: Tympole
short: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans.
alt1: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Palpitoad
short: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
alt1: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Seismitoad
short: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.
alt1: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists.

name: Throh
short: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger.
alt1: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it.

name: Sawk
short: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
alt1: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

name: Sewaddle
short: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
alt1: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched.

name: Swadloon
short: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
alt1: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves.

name: Leavanny
short: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves.
alt1: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Venipede
short: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
alt1: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail.

name: Whirlipede
short: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
alt1: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Scolipede
short: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
alt1: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving.

name: Cottonee
short: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find.
alt1: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body.

name: Whimsicott
short: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small.
alt1: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank.

name: Petilil
short: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
alt1: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
short: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom.
alt1: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect.

name: Basculin
short: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly.
alt1: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

name: Sandile
short: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes.
alt1: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming.

name: Krokorok
short: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
alt1: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night.

name: Krookodile
short: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
alt1: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Darumaka
short: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
alt1: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around.

name: Darmanitan
short: Its internal fire burns at 2,500º F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
alt1: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form.

name: Maractus
short: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
alt1: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Dwebble
short: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
alt1: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle
short: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously.
alt1: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

name: Scraggy
short: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
alt1: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
short: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks.
alt1: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory.

name: Sigilyph
short: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
alt1: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Yamask
short: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.
alt1: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves.

name: Cofagrigus
short: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
alt1: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies.

name: Tirtouga
short: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
alt1: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
short: They can live both in the ocean and on land.
alt1: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

name: Archen
short: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
alt1: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

name: Archeops
short: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey.
alt1: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

name: Trubbish
short: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week.
alt1: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
short: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
alt1: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
short: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
alt1: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them.

name: Zoroark
short: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
alt1: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously.

name: Minccino
short: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
alt1: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning.

name: Cinccino
short: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
alt1: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Gothita
short: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power.
alt1: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon.

name: Gothorita
short: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon.
alt1: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
short: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
alt1: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars.

name: Solosis
short: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power.
alt1: It communicates with others telepathically.

name: Duosion
short: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
alt1: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

name: Reuniclus
short: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
alt1: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Ducklett
short: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
alt1: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

name: Swanna
short: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
alt1: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Vanillite
short: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun.
alt1: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun.

name: Vanillish
short: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
alt1: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Vanilluxe
short: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
alt1: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Deerling
short: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur.
alt1: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass.

name: Sawsbuck
short: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.
alt1: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers.

name: Emolga
short: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
alt1: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Karrablast
short: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways.
alt1: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

name: Escavalier
short: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
alt1: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears.

name: Foongus
short: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores.
alt1: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

name: Amoonguss
short: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
alt1: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Frillish
short: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.
alt1: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Jellicent
short: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
alt1: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: Alomomola
short: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
alt1: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Joltik
short: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
alt1: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
short: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
alt1: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey.

name: Ferroseed
short: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first.
alt1: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling.

name: Ferrothorn
short: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
alt1: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers.

name: Klink
short: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
alt1: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klang
short: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others.
alt1: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

name: Klinklang
short: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
alt1: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Tynamo
short: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
alt1: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
short: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
alt1: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides.

name: Eelektross
short: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms.
alt1: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Elgyem
short: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.
alt1: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Beheeyem
short: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.
alt1: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

name: Litwick
short: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
alt1: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
short: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.
alt1: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
short: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
alt1: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Axew
short: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat.
alt1: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks.

name: Fraxure
short: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
alt1: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Haxorus
short: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory.
alt1: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

name: Cubchoo
short: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
alt1: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
short: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with.
alt1: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey.

name: Cryogonal
short: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
alt1: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes.

name: Shelmet
short: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
alt1: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell.

name: Accelgor
short: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
alt1: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Stunfisk
short: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers.
alt1: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore.

name: Mienfoo
short: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks.
alt1: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves.

name: Mienshao
short: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
alt1: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Druddigon
short: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey.
alt1: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings.

name: Golett
short: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
alt1: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay.

name: Golurk
short: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
alt1: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Pawniard
short: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
alt1: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp
short: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard.
alt1: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility.

name: Bouffalant
short: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
alt1: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Rufflet
short: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
alt1: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear.

name: Braviary
short: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves.
alt1: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Vullaby
short: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly.
alt1: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly.

name: Mandibuzz
short: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
alt1: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground.

name: Heatmor
short: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue.
alt1: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning.

name: Durant
short: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
alt1: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Deino
short: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
alt1: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings.

name: Zweilous
short: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
alt1: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area.

name: Hydreigon
short: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
alt1: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Larvesta
short: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes.
alt1: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun.

name: Volcarona
short: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.
alt1: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Cobalion
short: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
alt1: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Terrakion
short: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow.
alt1: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Virizion
short: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
alt1: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends.

name: Tornadus
short: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy.
alt1: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms.

name: Thundurus
short: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning.
alt1: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires.

name: Reshiram
short: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
alt1: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Zekrom
short: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.
alt1: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning.

name: Landorus
short: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."
alt1: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Kyurem
short: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
alt1: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Keldeo
short: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter.
alt1: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers.

name: Meloetta
short: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
alt1: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Genesect
short: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
alt1: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma.

name: Chespin
short: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
alt1: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

name: Quilladin
short: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks.
alt1: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another.

name: Chesnaught
short: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank.
alt1: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Fennekin
short: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
alt1: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack.

name: Braixen
short: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight.
alt1: It has a twig stuck in its tail.

name: Delphox
short: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
alt1: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Froakie
short: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles.
alt1: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back.

name: Frogadier
short: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.
alt1: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
short: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water.
alt1: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace.

name: Bunnelby
short: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
alt1: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Diggersby
short: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease.
alt1: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble.

name: Fletchling
short: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
alt1: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Fletchinder
short: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire.
alt1: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Talonflame
short: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
alt1: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph.

name: Scatterbug
short: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
alt1: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Spewpa
short: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body.
alt1: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location.

name: Vivillon
short: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat.
alt1: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world.

name: Litleo
short: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger.
alt1: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
short: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
alt1: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger.

name: Flabébé
short: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long.
alt1: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers.

name: Floette
short: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
alt1: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt.

name: Florges
short: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
alt1: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

name: Skiddo
short: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
alt1: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
short: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
alt1: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns.

name: Pancham
short: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.
alt1: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating.

name: Pangoro
short: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying.
alt1: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements.

name: Furfrou
short: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
alt1: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Espurr
short: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
alt1: My number one. Exceptionally cute. A little princess.

name: Meowstic
short: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
alt1: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy.

name: Honedge
short: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword.
alt1: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge.

name: Doublade
short: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
alt1: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

name: Aegislash
short: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others.
alt1: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership.

name: Spritzee
short: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it.
alt1: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Aromatisse
short: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
alt1: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Swirlix
short: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
alt1: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
short: It can distinguish the faintest of scents.
alt1: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition.

name: Inkay
short: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight.
alt1: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash.

name: Malamar
short: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
alt1: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Binacle
short: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
alt1: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together.

name: Barbaracle
short: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently.
alt1: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle.

name: Skrelp
short: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.
alt1: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: Dragalge
short: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.
alt1: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near.

name: Clauncher
short: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
alt1: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot.

name: Clawitzer
short: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.
alt1: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Helioptile
short: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.
alt1: They make their home in deserts.

name: Heliolisk
short: They flare their frills and generate energy.
alt1: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon.

name: Tyrunt
short: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile.
alt1: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil.

name: Tyrantrum
short: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.
alt1: The king of the ancient world, it can easily crunch a car with the devastating strength of its enormous jaws.

name: Amaura
short: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.
alt1: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It’s said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.

name: Aurorus
short: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.
alt1: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

name: Sylveon
short: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
alt1: There's a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.

name: Hawlucha
short: With its wings, it controls its position in the air.
alt1: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Dedenne
short: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings.
alt1: Its whiskers serve as antennas.

name: Carbink
short: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.
alt1: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth.

name: Goomy
short: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.
alt1: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

name: Sliggoo
short: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system.
alt1: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything.

name: Goodra
short: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
alt1: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Klefki
short: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
alt1: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki.

name: Phantump
short: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.
alt1: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest.

name: Trevenant
short: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest.
alt1: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: Pumpkaboo
short: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world.
alt1: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.

name: Gourgeist
short: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon.
alt1: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking.

name: Bergmite
short: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid.
alt1: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body.

name: Avalugg
short: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
alt1: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Noibat
short: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
alt1: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern
short: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey.
alt1: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Xerneas
short: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
alt1: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Yveltal
short: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
alt1: Hidden away in its jet-black wings is a red passion.

name: Zygarde
short: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
alt1: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

name: Diancie
short: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
alt1: Open the magic door and a dream-colored party will start again today.

name: Hoopa
short: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
alt1: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Volcanion
short: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back.
alt1: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog.

name: Rowlet
short: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
alt1: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about.

name: Dartrix
short: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point.
alt1: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings.

name: Decidueye
short: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings.
alt1: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents.

name: Litten
short: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach.
alt1: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you.

name: Torracat
short: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
alt1: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

name: Incineroar
short: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
alt1: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition.

name: Popplio
short: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes.
alt1: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
short: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.
alt1: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

name: Primarina
short: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle.
alt1: It controls its water balloons with song.

name: Pikipek
short: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won't hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.
alt1: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty.

name: Trumbeak
short: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.
alt1: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

name: Toucannon
short: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
alt1: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

name: Yungoos
short: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything.
alt1: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
short: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.
alt1: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Grubbin
short: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
alt1: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Charjabug
short: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.
alt1: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
short: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen.
alt1: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen.

name: Crabrawler
short: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly.
alt1: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense.

name: Crabominable
short: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain.
alt1: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes.

name: Oricorio
short: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.
alt1: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar.

name: Cutiefly
short: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers.
alt1: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be.

name: Ribombee
short: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
alt1: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious.

name: Rockruff
short: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you.
alt1: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive.

name: Lycanroc
short: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
alt1: Its quick movements confuse its enemies.

name: Wishiwashi
short: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine.
alt1: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Mareanie
short: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey.
alt1: The first symptom of its sting is numbness.

name: Toxapex
short: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs.
alt1: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights.

name: Mudbray
short: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
alt1: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon.

name: Mudsdale
short: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone.
alt1: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Dewpider
short: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
alt1: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other.

name: Araquanid
short: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head.
alt1: It usually passes its time in the water.

name: Fomantis
short: Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.
alt1: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

name: Lurantis
short: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon.
alt1: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing.

name: Morelull
short: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
alt1: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots.

name: Shiinotic
short: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness.
alt1: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night.

name: Salandit
short: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas.
alt1: The males will do whatever the females tell them.

name: Salazzle
short: For some reason, only females have been found.
alt1: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Stufful
short: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
alt1: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half.

name: Bewear
short: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength.
alt1: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous.

name: Bounsweet
short: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.
alt1: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit.

name: Steenee
short: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated.
alt1: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body.

name: Tsareena
short: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill.
alt1: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

name: Comfey
short: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them.
alt1: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine.

name: Oranguru
short: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides.
alt1: It knows the forest inside and out.

name: Passimian
short: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role.
alt1: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Wimpod
short: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things.
alt1: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger.

name: Golisopod
short: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
alt1: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond.

name: Sandygast
short: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
alt1: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth.

name: Palossand
short: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
alt1: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle.

name: Pyukumuku
short: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
alt1: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach.

name: Type: Null
short: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities.
alt1: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth.

name: Silvally
short: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
alt1: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved.

name: Minior
short: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.
alt1: This is its form when its shell has fallen off.

name: Komala
short: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
alt1: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Turtonator
short: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck.
alt1: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils.

name: Togedemaru
short: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
alt1: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods.

name: Mimikyu
short: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
alt1: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Bruxish
short: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth.
alt1: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain.

name: Drampa
short: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered.
alt1: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height.

name: Dhelmise
short: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.
alt1: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality.

name: Jangmo-o
short: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales.
alt1: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents.

name: Hakamo-o
short: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout.
alt1: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis.

name: Kommo-o
short: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail.
alt1: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense.

name: Tapu Koko
short: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity.
alt1: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow.

name: Tapu Lele
short: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales.
alt1: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel.

name: Tapu Bulu
short: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
alt1: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around.

name: Tapu Fini
short: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water.
alt1: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies.

name: Cosmog
short: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
alt1: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmoem
short: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell.
alt1: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch.

name: Solgaleo
short: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."
alt1: It is said to live in another world.

name: Lunala
short: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
alt1: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog.

name: Nihilego
short: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
alt1: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole.

name: Buzzwole
short: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast.
alt1: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Pheromosa
short: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.
alt1: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Xurkitree
short: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.
alt1: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts.

name: Celesteela
short: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.
alt1: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Kartana
short: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
alt1: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Guzzlord
short: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.
alt1: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Necrozma
short: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy.
alt1: Light is apparently the source of its energy.

name: Magearna
short: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
alt1: Magearna, with its metallic body, is an artificial Pokémon created 500 years ago by humans.

name: Marshadow
short: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements.
alt1: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: Poipole
short: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
alt1: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Naganadel
short: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body.
alt1: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles.

name: Stakataka
short: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
alt1: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
short: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head.
alt1: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Zeraora
short: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
alt1: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Meltan
