short: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
alt1: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
short: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart.
alt1: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Grookey
short: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
alt1: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
short: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
alt1: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
short: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump.
alt1: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop.

name: Scorbunny
short: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body.
alt1: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose.

name: Raboot
short: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
alt1: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Cinderace
short: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on.
alt1: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball.

name: Sobble
short: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
alt1: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
short: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
alt1: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
short: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
alt1: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Skwovet
short: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again.
alt1: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks.

name: Greedent
short: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly.
alt1: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Rookidee
short: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful.
alt1: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

name: Corvisquire
short: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.
alt1: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
short: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region.
alt1: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

name: Blipbug
short: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
alt1: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart.

name: Dottler
short: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
alt1: It barely moves, but it's still alive.

name: Orbeetle
short: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
alt1: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Nickit
short: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon.
alt1: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others.

name: Thievul
short: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent.
alt1: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs.

name: Gossifleur
short: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song.
alt1: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun.

name: Eldegoss
short: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
alt1: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients.

name: Wooloo
short: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move.
alt1: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
short: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender.
alt1: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline.

name: Chewtle
short: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
alt1: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
short: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
alt1: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Yamper
short: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats.
alt1: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region.

name: Boltund
short: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong.
alt1: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength.

name: Rolycoly
short: Most of its body has the same composition as coal.
alt1: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain.

name: Carkol
short: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph.
alt1: It forms coal inside its body.

name: Coalossal
short: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it.
alt1: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered.

name: Applin
short: It spends its entire life inside an apple.
alt1: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple.

name: Flapple
short: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution.
alt1: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid.

name: Appletun
short: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution.
alt1: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy.

name: Silicobra
short: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
alt1: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch.

name: Sandaconda
short: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
alt1: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose.

name: Cramorant
short: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain.
alt1: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
short: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw.
alt1: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish.

name: Barraskewda
short: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel.
alt1: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Toxel
short: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity.
alt1: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin.

name: Toxtricity
short: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.
alt1: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Sizzlipede
short: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat.
alt1: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils.

name: Centiskorch
short: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
alt1: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Clobbopus
short: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles.
alt1: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back.

name: Grapploct
short: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land.
alt1: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Sinistea
short: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
alt1: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea.

name: Polteageist
short: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
alt1: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor.

name: Hatenna
short: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions.
alt1: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can.

name: Hattrem
short: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
alt1: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down.

name: Hatterene
short: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
alt1: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle.

name: Impidimp
short: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed.
alt1: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
short: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods.
alt1: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
short: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
alt1: Its hairs work like muscle fibers.

name: Obstagoon
short: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
alt1: Its voice is staggering in volume.

name: Perrserker
short: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
alt1: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair.

name: Cursola
short: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy.
alt1: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul.

name: Sirfetch’d
short: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk.
alt1: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution.

name: Mr. Rime
short: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
alt1: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Runerigus
short: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
alt1: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting.

name: Milcery
short: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air.
alt1: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
short: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
alt1: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Falinks
short: The six of them work together as one Pokémon.
alt1: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass.

name: Pincurchin
short: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks.
alt1: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food.

name: Snom
short: It eats snow that piles up on the ground.
alt1: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground.

name: Frosmoth
short: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains.
alt1: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae.

name: Stonjourner
short: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon.
alt1: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
short: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.
alt1: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place.

name: Indeedee
short: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.
alt1: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others.

name: Morpeko
short: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.
alt1: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger.

name: Cufant
short: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it.
alt1: It digs up the ground with its trunk.

name: Copperajah
short: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans.
alt1: These Pokémon live in herds.

name: Dracozolt
short: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
alt1: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity.

name: Arctozolt
short: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity.
alt1: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body.

name: Dracovish
short: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time.
alt1: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

name: Arctovish
short: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
alt1: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Duraludon
short: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong.
alt1: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant.

name: Dreepy
short: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it.
alt1: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them.

name: Drakloak
short: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph.
alt1: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out.

name: Dragapult
short: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns.
alt1: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Zacian
short: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.
alt1: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Zamazenta
short: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield.
alt1: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region.

name: Eternatus
short: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago.
alt1: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region.

name: Kubfu
short: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
alt1: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: Urshifu
short: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
alt1: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO.

name: Zarude
short: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil.
alt1: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind.

name: Regieleki
short: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy.
alt1: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy.

name: Regidrago
short: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy.
alt1: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon.

name: Glastrier
short: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves.
alt1: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Spectrier
short: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight.
alt1: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures.

name: Calyrex
short: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings.
alt1: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times.

name: Wyrdeer
short: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers.

name: Kleavor
short: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.

name: Ursaluna
short: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Basculegion
short: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.

name: Sneasler
short: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands.

name: Overqwil
short: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname “sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Enamorus
short: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end.

name: Sprigatito
short: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants.
alt1: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it.

name: Floragato
short: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
alt1: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood.

name: Meowscarada
short: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs.
alt1: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Fuecoco
short: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
alt1: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out.

name: Crocalor
short: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.
alt1: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords.

name: Skeledirge
short: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it.
alt1: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings.

name: Quaxly
short: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago.
alt1: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers.

name: Quaxwell
short: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
alt1: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Quaquaval
short: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling.
alt1: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it.

name: Lechonk
short: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.
alt1: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods.

name: Oinkologne
short: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin.
alt1: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about.

name: Tarountula
short: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire.
alt1: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Spidops
short: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound.
alt1: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire.

name: Nymble
short: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
alt1: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Lokix
short: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode.
alt1: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode.

name: Pawmi
short: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs.
alt1: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks.

name: Pawmo
short: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
alt1: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
short: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
alt1: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Tandemaus
short: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
alt1: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Maushold
short: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles.
alt1: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

name: Fidough
short: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch.
alt1: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dachsbun
short: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
alt1: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Smoliv
short: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head.
alt1: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head.

name: Dolliv
short: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others.
alt1: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen.

name: Arboliva
short: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
alt1: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Squawkabilly
short: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
alt1: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities.

name: Nacli
short: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth.
alt1: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind.

name: Naclstack
short: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them.
alt1: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
short: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt.
alt1: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Charcadet
short: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon.
alt1: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Armarouge
short: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior.
alt1: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Ceruledge
short: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
alt1: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution.

name: Tadbulb
short: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity.
alt1: It floats using the electricity stored in its body.

name: Bellibolt
short: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
alt1: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

name: Wattrel
short: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity.
alt1: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs.

name: Kilowattrel
short: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity.
alt1: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings.

name: Maschiff
short: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
alt1: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

name: Mabosstiff
short: Mabosstiff loves playing with children.
alt1: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap.

name: Shroodle
short: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
alt1: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Grafaiai
short: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats.
alt1: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Bramblin
short: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
alt1: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind.

name: Brambleghast
short: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey.
alt1: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions.

name: Toedscool
short: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species.
alt1: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: Toedscruel
short: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain.
alt1: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests.

name: Klawf
short: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey.
alt1: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs.

name: Capsakid
short: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
alt1: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
short: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain.
alt1: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Rellor
short: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy.
alt1: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures.

name: Rabsca
short: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
alt1: An infant sleeps inside the ball.

name: Flittle
short: It spends its time running around wastelands.
alt1: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Espathra
short: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes.
alt1: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Tinkatink
short: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
alt1: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer.

name: Tinkatuff
short: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal.
alt1: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Tinkaton
short: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition.
alt1: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Wiglett
short: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
alt1: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species.

name: Wugtrio
short: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest.
alt1: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Bombirdier
short: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest.
alt1: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

name: Finizen
short: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail.
alt1: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
short: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.
alt1: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

name: Varoom
short: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
alt1: The steel section is Varoom's actual body.

name: Revavroom
short: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks.
alt1: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust.

name: Cyclizar
short: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times.
alt1: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human.

name: Orthworm
short: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
alt1: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Glimmet
short: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
alt1: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals.

name: Glimmora
short: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
alt1: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy.

name: Greavard
short: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone.
alt1: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Houndstone
short: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone.
alt1: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards.

name: Flamigo
short: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
alt1: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Cetoddle
short: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals.
alt1: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago.

name: Cetitan
short: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas.
alt1: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Veluza
short: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases.
alt1: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities.

name: Dondozo
short: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food.
alt1: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally.

name: Tatsugiri
short: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
alt1: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Annihilape
short: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart.
alt1: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Clodsire
short: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body.
alt1: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps.

name: Farigiraf
short: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
alt1: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Dudunsparce
short: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground.
alt1: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Kingambit
short: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
alt1: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies.

name: Great Tusk
short: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years.
alt1: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey.

name: Scream Tail
short: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon.
alt1: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Brute Bonnet
short: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
alt1: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
short: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
alt1: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Slither Wing
short: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
alt1: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Sandy Shocks
short: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught.
alt1: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Treads
short: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years.
alt1: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks.

name: Iron Bundle
short: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book.
alt1: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article.

name: Iron Hands
short: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
alt1: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine.

name: Iron Jugulis
short: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
alt1: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: Iron Moth
short: No records exist of this species being caught.
alt1: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

name: Iron Thorns
short: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
alt1: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: Frigibax
short: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy.
alt1: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas.

name: Arctibax
short: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
alt1: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air.

name: Baxcalibur
short: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth.
alt1: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth.

name: Gimmighoul
short: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago.
alt1: It lives inside an old treasure chest.

name: Gholdengo
short: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins.
alt1: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins.

name: Wo-Chien
short: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
alt1: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

name: Chien-Pao
short: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
alt1: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow.

name: Ting-Lu
short: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
alt1: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi-Yu
short: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
alt1: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
short: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
alt1: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Iron Valiant
short: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
alt1: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Koraidon
short: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal.
alt1: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious.

name: Miraidon
short: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book.
alt1: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Walking Wake
short: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery.
alt1: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Iron Leaves
short: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
alt1: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Dipplin
short: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm.
alt1: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: Poltchageist
short: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
alt1: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
short: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards.
alt1: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force.

name: Okidogi
short: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
alt1: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

name: Munkidori
short: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
alt1: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities.

name: Fezandipiti
short: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
alt1: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

name: Ogerpon
short: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity.
alt1: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing.

name: Archaludon
short: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings.
alt1: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food.

name: Hydrapple
short: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup.
alt1: These capricious syrpents have banded together.

name: Gouging Fire
short: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted.
alt1: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine.

name: Raging Bolt
short: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur.
alt1: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

name: Iron Boulder
short: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book.
alt1: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

name: Iron Crown
short: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces.
alt1: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.

name: Terapagos
short: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy.
alt1: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals.

name: Pecharunt
short: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison.
alt1: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities.
